description: Canonical integration-checker input: 2 phase summaries that should integrate (Phase 1 emits a JWT format; Phase 2 consumes it) but with a deliberate cross-phase mismatch (Phase 1 says HS256, Phase 2 expects RS256). Expected output: integration-issues report. Schema-conformance baseline.
prompt: Spawn the gsd-integration-checker agent. Read phase-1-summary.md and phase-2-summary.md in the sandbox. Identify any cross-phase integration mismatches (contract drift, dependency violations, format mismatches). Output integration-issues as JSON: { issues: [{ severity, source_phase, target_phase, description, fix }] }.

sandbox_files.phase-1-summary.md:
# Phase 1: Auth Summary

Delivered: POST /auth/login issues JWT signed with HS256, 1h expiry, secret in env JWT_SECRET. Token format: standard JWT 3-segment.
sandbox_files.phase-2-summary.md:
# Phase 2: API Authorization Summary

Verifies incoming JWT using `jose.jwtVerify(token, publicKey, { algorithms: ['RS256'] })`. Loads public key from JWKS endpoint /jwks.json.
